result.summary: The image shows an urban intersection with basic pedestrian infrastructure including marked zebra crosswalks, sidewalks, and pedestrian signals. While functional, the environment lacks advanced traffic calming measures like curb extensions or refuge islands to further protect pedestrians in this high-density mixed-use area.

hazards.name: Lack of physical protection
hazards.description: Pedestrians crossing the street have no physical refuge or protection from turning vehicles beyond paint and signals.

hazards.name: Potential sightline obstruction
hazards.description: Street furniture and parked vehicles near the corner may partially obscure pedestrians from the view of approaching drivers.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces closest to the intersection to ensure clear sightlines for all road users.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program the traffic signal to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before vehicles get a green light.

result.summary: The image depicts a signalized urban intersection with a marked zebra crosswalk and tactile curb ramps in a dense commercial area. While basic pedestrian infrastructure is present, including 'No Turn on Red' signage, there are no visible dedicated pedestrian signals or physical traffic calming measures.

hazards.name: Lack of visible pedestrian signal
hazards.description: No dedicated pedestrian signal head is visible to provide timing information for people crossing the street.
hazards.location_in_image: On the signal pole at the right corner.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to improve predictability and safety for crossing pedestrians.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs to reduce the crossing distance and improve the visibility between pedestrians and motorists.

result.summary: This urban environment features basic pedestrian infrastructure including sidewalks and a marked crosswalk at a signalized intersection. However, the pedestrian experience is compromised by sidewalk obstructions from construction materials and uneven pavement surfaces.

hazards.name: Sidewalk Obstruction
hazards.description: Construction barriers and materials on the left sidewalk significantly narrow the path for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Uneven Pavement
hazards.description: The sidewalk surface is patched and uneven, creating potential tripping hazards.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles along the right side of the street may block sightlines between pedestrians and approaching traffic.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the intersection to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Rehabilitation
interventions.description: Repair and level the sidewalk pavement to ensure a smooth, accessible surface for all users.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to improve sightlines.

result.summary: The intersection features high-visibility continental crosswalks and pedestrian signals, providing basic infrastructure for walkers. However, the lack of physical protection like curb extensions and the presence of a vehicle parked close to the crossing create sightline issues and increased exposure.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction (Daylighting)
hazards.description: A white SUV is parked immediately adjacent to the crosswalk, obstructing the sightlines between pedestrians and approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Left foreground, near the crosswalk entrance.

hazards.name: Lack of Physical Protection
hazards.description: The absence of curb extensions or bollards at the corners increases the crossing distance and allows for higher-speed vehicle turns.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten the crossing distance and improve pedestrian visibility to drivers.

interventions.title: Daylighting / Parking Restrictions
interventions.description: Implement parking restrictions within 20 feet of the crosswalk to ensure clear sightlines for all road users.
